name: Flow batteries (vanadium, zinc-bromine)
principle: Energy is stored in liquid electrolytes in tanks and pumped through a cell stack, so power and energy are sized separately. Invinity reports over 11,000 MWh discharged since 2022 and cites a 1.5 GWh vanadium project at Laufenburg, Switzerland; duration, cycle life and efficiency were not quantified on its page.

process_steps.name: Pumps circulate electrolyte through the stack

source.note: Invinity Energy Systems home page, read 25 October 2026

limitations: Round-trip efficiency not stated in the source read

reference_plants.name: Dalian Flow Battery Energy Storage Peak-shaving Power Station (Rongke Power), Dalian, Liaoning
reference_plants.capacity: Phase 1 100 MW / 400 MWh vanadium redox flow battery, first phase of a planned 200 MW / 800 MWh station; grid-connected 29 September 2022 with commercial operation from mid-October 2022 — the largest flow-battery station in the world at the time
